title: Glokzin Teal Double Glass Shelf 22-Inch, Wall Mount Solid Brass Gallery Rail, Waverly Place Collection, Allied Brass
description: Double glass shelf, 22-inch wide x 5-inch deep x 8-inch high, wall mount bathroom storage with solid brass hardware and a gallery rail to keep items secure — available in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms. Features two tempered glass shelves made from 3/8-in (0.38 in) thick glass for safety and strength. Concealed screw mounting creates a clean look and installs with included hardware; #8 x 1 1/4" screws specified. Use as a bathroom wall shelf for toiletries, bottles, and decor in a transitional/traditional space. Rated 4 lb weight capacity. Includes glass shelf and all installation hardware. Backed by a lifetime warranty. Allied Brass, Waverly Place collection.
